name: @gate/server
description: GATE HTTP server: Hono app, platform adapters, and entry points for Workers, Node, Bun, Lambda, and Vercel.

scripts.build: pnpm run config:compile && wrangler deploy --config ../../wrangler.jsonc --dry-run --outdir dist/worker && node scripts/bundle.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p src/platforms/cloudflare/tsconfig.json && tsc -p test/workers/tsconfig.json
